sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Feels as if a sharp instrument were thrust
through from temple to temple. Constriction across
forehead. Nervous headache, after suppressed per-
spiration, followed by increased urine, with increase of
specific gravity. Headache from retention of effete
matters in system.

sections.label: fever
sections.text:
When the drug did not cause sweating or profuse urination, it

caused violent headache, with vertigo, quick, full pulse, and

nausea.
■ Rheumatic headaches.

Disordered feeling, with slight pain in 1. side of head.
At times severe pain for several hours in whole of 1. head.
® Ears. Shooting pain in 1. ear.

A striking, well-marked belching of the food with its proper

tion of rawness in the stomach and a slight pain.

and inclination to stool.
Rawness in stomach after vomiting. See 16.
Heat of stomach and abdomen.

rhoea.

^^ Male Sexual Organs. Tickling sensation at the end of penis.
